title: Run matches in the arena
lead: `arena run a.s b.s --seed N`: assemble the bots, place them from the seed, schedule round-robin, stop at the cycle limit, and print a text result.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** writing replay files, tournaments, viewers.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Milestone 4 and goals 3-4. Every later feature runs matches through this.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- Arena module (wraps the pure VM core) and its tests.
- The `arena run` subcommand.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- Placement for a fixed seed matches the match spec's worked examples, is non-overlapping and honors min separation.
- Placement that cannot fit returns the spec's error.
- Turn order between two hand-built bots matches the spec.
- The cycle limit stops the match and reports survivors.
- The tie rule, a single winner, and a dead bot each produce the spec's result.
- The same bots, seed and config run twice give identical results.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
- The seeded RNG from the match spec, in-repo (C13).
- The CLI stays non-interactive and scriptable so the later agent harness can drive it (C09). Gap: PROJECT.md does not define a machine-readable output; raise it with the owner.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- The project test command passes.
- `arena run x.s y.s --seed 1` run twice gives byte-identical output (`diff` of the two outputs is empty).

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Branch `slice/<id>-arena` in `.worktrees/<id>`. One commit when the owner asks.
